entities.name: Reed Boat
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: Boats woven from papyrus reeds or bulrushes. Light, buoyant, and easy to build — they served as fishing boats, ferries, and cargo vessels on the Nile, Tigris, and Euphrates rivers.
